import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/test_1.csv"

# Load Source 0: Source1_79_0
# Schema: ['Country', 'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
#          'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17']
df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# Load Source 1: Source1_79_1
# Schema: ['Country', 'Region', 'Happiness Rank', 'Happiness Score', 'Standard Error', 'Economy (GDP per Capita)',
#          'Family', 'Health (Life Expectancy)', 'Freedom', 'Trust (Government Corruption)', 'Generosity', 'Dystopia Residual']
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Rename Source 1 columns to match target schema for 2015 data
df_source1_renamed = df_source1.rename(columns={
    'Happiness Rank': 'Happiness_Rank_15',
    'Happiness Score': 'Happiness_Score_15',
    'Standard Error': 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy (GDP per Capita)': 'Economy_15',
    'Family': 'Family_15',
    'Health (Life Expectancy)': 'Life_Expectancy_15',
    'Freedom': 'Freedom_15',
    'Trust (Government Corruption)': 'Trust_15',
    'Generosity': 'Generosity_15',
    'Dystopia Residual': 'Dystopia_15'
})

# The target table has columns for both 2015 and 2017 data.
# Source 1 provides 2015 data + Region.
# Source 0 provides 2017 data without Region.
# We join on 'Country' to combine 2015 and 2017 data.
# The target schema columns are:
# ['Country', 'Region', 'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15',
#  'Family_15', 'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
#  'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17', 'Economy_17',
#  'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17']

# Join Source 1 (2015 data) with Source 0 (2017 data) on 'Country'
df_merged = pd.merge(
    df_source1_renamed,
    df_source0,
    on='Country',
    how='inner',
    validate='one_to_one'  # Expect one row per country in each source
)

# Select and reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'Country', 'Region',
    'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15',
    'Family_15', 'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
    'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17', 'Economy_17',
    'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]

df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

# Enforce data types as per target schema
df_target = df_target.astype({
    'Country': 'string',
    'Region': 'string',
    'Happiness_Rank_15': 'Int64',
    'Happiness_Score_15': 'float64',
    'Standard_Error_15': 'float64',
    'Economy_15': 'float64',
    'Family_15': 'float64',
    'Life_Expectancy_15': 'float64',
    'Freedom_15': 'float64',
    'Trust_15': 'float64',
    'Generosity_15': 'float64',
    'Dystopia_15': 'float64',
    'Happiness_Rank_17': 'Int64',
    'Happiness_Score_17': 'float64',
    'Whisker_High_17': 'float64',
    'Whisker_Low_17': 'float64',
    'Economy_17': 'float64',
    'Family_17': 'float64',
    'Life_Expectancy_17': 'float64',
    'Freedom_17': 'float64',
    'Generosity_17': 'float64',
    'Trust_17': 'float64',
    'Dystopia_17': 'float64'
})

# Write the transformed data to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
